The test image shows the **lower surface of a soybean leaf** held up by hand, displaying numerous small scattered tan/orange-brown spots distributed across the entire leaf surface. The spots are tiny, somewhat uniform in size, and scattered within areas of slight yellowing.

**Key observations:**
- Lower leaf surface view
- Numerous small, tan to reddish-brown pustule-like lesions scattered throughout
- Slight yellowing around lesion areas
- Pattern is diffuse and widespread, not angular or vein-delimited

**Matching to Soybean_rust:** The description states lesions appear on lower leaf surfaces as small gray spots turning tan/reddish-brown, scattered within yellow areas. Mature lesions contain small pustules on lower leaf surfaces. The reference collage (upper-right panel) shows exactly this pattern — dense small tan/brown spots on the leaf underside — which matches the test image precisely.

This is distinct from Septoria (angular brown spots), Bacterial_Blight (angular with yellow halo), or Cercospora (upper surface only, purple/leathery).
